Admin routes of the pages module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/pages

List all CMS pages including unpublished

Parameters:

- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## POST /v1/admin/pages

Create new CMS page

Request body: [CreatePageAdminDto](#createpageadmindto).

Responses:

- `201`: no description.

## DELETE /v1/admin/pages/{id}

Soft-delete CMS page

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: no description.

## PATCH /v1/admin/pages/{id}

Update CMS page

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdatePageAdminDto](#updatepageadmindto).

Responses:

- `200`: no description.

## Schemas

### CreatePageAdminDto

- `slug` (string, pattern `/^(?:\/[a-z0-9-]+)+$/`, max length 200, required).
- `type` (object, required).
- `title` ([TranslatableDto](#translatabledto), required).
- `content` ([TranslatableDto](#translatabledto), required).
- `isPublished` (boolean, optional).
- `metaTitle` ([TranslatableDto](#translatabledto), optional).
- `metaDescription` ([TranslatableDto](#translatabledto), optional).
- `sortOrder` (number, min 0, optional).
- `showInNavigation` (boolean, optional).
- `template` (string, max length 100, optional).

### TranslatableDto

- `fr` (string, optional).
- `en` (string, optional).
- `ar` (string, optional).
- `default` (string, required).
